listings.name: VITZ Travel & Tours
listings.current_description: VITZ Travel and Tours is a Brooklands Lifestyle Estate-based tour and transfer company offering guided excursions to destinations such as Soweto, the Cradle of Humankind and the Apartheid Museum, plus airport transfers and Mercedes-Benz vehicle rentals.

listings.name: Vonk Creative Solutions
listings.current_description: Vonk Creative Solutions designs and manufactures loadbin racks and industrial rack accessories for bakkies (pickup trucks) in Weavind Park, including Supercab, Double Cab, Highrise and custom configurations, using 3D CAD design, CNC laser-cutting and powder coating.

listings.name: Warp Development
listings.current_description: Warp Development is a technology consulting and software development firm offering AI consulting, enterprise software development, IT infrastructure management and staff augmentation, operating from The Willows with clients across South Africa, the US, Europe and Australia.

listings.name: Water Shop Eco Park Centurion
listings.current_description: Water Shop Eco Park Centurion is a retail outlet of the RO Water brand, selling water purification and filtration equipment, including reverse osmosis systems and replacement filters, for home and business use, in Eco Park Estate.

listings.name: Waterfalls Boutique Hotel
listings.current_description: Waterfalls Boutique Hotel is a boutique guest house in Waterkloof Park offering standard, luxury, superior king and honeymoon suites for up to 24 guests, with an outdoor pool, hot tub and landscaped gardens featuring koi ponds.

listings.name: Waterplaas Elarduspark
listings.current_description: Waterplaas is a water-shop franchise selling water on tap, bottled water, water containers and locally sourced products such as Big B Atchar and Waterplaas Spices, with over 30 outlets across South Africa including this Elarduspark branch.

listings.name: Wierda Park Butchery
listings.current_description: Wierda Park Butchery is a butchery in Wierda Park, Centurion, supplying beef, lamb, pork, chicken, boerewors, cold meats, bacon, dry-aged steaks, game meat and spit braai rentals, made from Class A meat with no added fillers.

listings.name: Yellow Pocket (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Yellow Pocket (Pty) Ltd, based in Hazeldean, is a creative digital agency offering web design and development, graphic design and branding, video and animation production, and web hosting, with a portfolio of more than 130 websites.

listings.name: A Bach Waste Management (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: A Bach Waste Management provides waste removal and recycling services to shopping centres, business parks, residential estates and commercial and industrial clients, including wheelie-bin services, skip-bin hire, recycling and hazardous-material disposal, from its base in Bon Accord.

listings.name: A & H Wendy Houses
listings.current_description: A & H Wendy Houses manufactures timber Wendy houses and cabins fitted with wooden floors, glass windows and fibre-cement or corrugated-iron roofs, and also offers free removal of an existing Wendy house when installing a new one.

listings.name: Absolute Solar Solutions
listings.current_description: Absolute Solar Solutions is the sister company of Absolute Chilled and a qualified PV GreenCard installer, providing turnkey solar solutions in Hennopspark including solar panels, lithium-ion batteries, inverters and charge controllers, with free onsite consultations across Gauteng.

listings.name: Accolades Decor
listings.current_description: Accolades Decor has been providing wedding and event decor styling and rentals since 2010, offering full styling packages plus individual hire of items such as draping, flowers, staging, dancefloors, cakes and lighting from its Elardus Park office.

listings.name: ACDC Express Centurion
listings.current_description: ACDC Express Centurion is an electrical retail store in Miracle Retail Park on Lenchen Avenue, part of the ACDC Express franchise network, stocking tools, solar equipment, automation gear, switchgear, cabling and electrical accessories sourced from ACDC Dynamics.

listings.name: ADVANCED PRINTER-INK TECHNOLOGIES
listings.current_description: Advanced Printer-Ink Technologies is a printer consumables supplier at Madelief Centre in Dorandia, offering original and generic ink and toner cartridges for major printer brands including HP, Canon, Brother and Kyocera, along with printer maintenance and repairs.

listings.name: Afcosja Renovations
listings.current_description: Afcosja Renovations is a Mountain View-based home renovation company with over 19 years of experience, offering building renovations, carpentry, plumbing and roofing services; the business grew from a handyman service into a full-time renovation company in 2003.

listings.name: Aldes Business Broker
listings.current_description: This branch of Aldes Business Broker (trading as Aldes Infinity) is led by an Independent Certified Financial Planner with a background at Standard Bank structuring large institutional investments, helping clients buy and sell small and medium businesses.

listings.name: Alectra Solutions
listings.current_description: The Wonderboom branch of Alectra Solutions is the company's flagship security shop, supplying security and automation products such as gate motors, CCTV systems, electric fencing, intercoms and garage door operators to homeowners and trade installers since 2012.

listings.name: Amalfi Place
listings.current_description: Amalfi Place is a 4-star self-catering guesthouse in Garsfontein, Pretoria East, offering two double units each with an en-suite bathroom and kitchenette, secure parking, free Wi-Fi and solar backup power, about 2km from the Menlyn Maine precinct.

listings.name: Amalgamated Technical Services
listings.current_description: Amalgamated Technical Services (ATS Africa) is a Pretoria-based group of specialised industrial services companies offering rope access work, boilermaking and welding, sandblasting and coating, non-destructive testing and total facilities maintenance for the construction, mining and petrochemical sectors.

listings.name: Amchem (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Amchem is a raw-material supplier based in Southdowns, Centurion, serving the pharmaceutical, nutrition, personal care, industrial, healthcare and animal health industries with products including petroleum jelly and waxes, backed by warehousing in Durban, Cape Town and Johannesburg.

listings.name: Amorie Burns Psychologist
listings.current_description: Amorie Burns is a counselling psychologist in Lynnwood, Pretoria, in private practice since 2016, who completed her Masters in Psychology at the University of Pretoria and has worked as part of bariatric surgery teams in the city.

listings.name: ANM Accountants
listings.current_description: ANM Accountants is a Centurion-based accounting and tax practice in Eldoraigne, offering financial statements, VAT, bookkeeping, payroll, BEE and company registration services, with the expertise of a large firm and the personal attention of a small practice.

listings.name: ANM Accountants – Small Business Accounting & Tax Solutions
listings.current_description: ANM Accountants - Small Business Accounting & Tax Solutions is the Eldoraigne office of ANM Accountants, based at the QPS Building on Saxby Road, providing tax planning, VAT guidance, payroll and company registration support to small businesses.

listings.name: Anthrop Abbott Architects
listings.current_description: Anthrop Abbott Architects is an award-winning architecture practice in Ashlea Gardens, Pretoria, established in 2013 by Leon van der Westhuizen and Roald Meyer and merged with Abbott BEC in 2023, specialising in commercial, residential and social-development projects.

listings.name: Apostil.co.za
listings.current_description: Apostil.co.za is a privately owned documentation services firm in Muckleneuk, Pretoria, assisting clients with apostilles, notarisations, authentications, police clearances, and birth, marriage and death certificates by applying for and couriering the documents on their behalf.

listings.name: Appliance Repair Shop
listings.current_description: Appliance Repair Shop is a Pretoria and Centurion appliance repair business in Eloffsdal with more than 35 years in the industry, servicing refrigerators, washing machines, dishwashers, freezers, stoves and tumble dryers with a 3-month warranty on repairs.

listings.name: AQUA PURA WATER REFILL & FILTER, Waterkloof Rand
listings.current_description: Aqua Pura Water Refill & Filter is a Waterkloof Rand branch of Aqua Pura, selling water purification products including filtration jugs and single, double and triple-stage water filters, plus water refill services, at the Waterkloof Rand Centre.

listings.name: Arte Construction
listings.current_description: Arte Construction (Arte Architects) is an architecture practice founded in 2014 by Wouter Erasmus and Johann le Roux, based in Cornwall Hill Country Estate, Centurion, designing contemporary, energy-efficient and environmentally sensitive buildings for residential and commercial clients.

listings.name: Atlas Finance Eastlynne
listings.current_description: Atlas Finance Eastlynne is a branch of the Atlas Finance short-term lending chain at Eastside Plaza, East Lynne, Pretoria, offering payday loans, debt review clearance, cross-border money transfers and domestic worker loans from R500 to R20,000.

listings.name: Bageso Housing Development Consultants
listings.current_description: Bageso Housing & Development Consultants is a BEE-certified pre-construction planning firm established in 2003, based on Puzzlewood Street in Brooklands Lifestyle Estate, Centurion, led by a professional planner registered with the South African Council for Planners (SACPLAN).

listings.name: Bakers Bin
listings.current_description: Bakers Bin is a wholesale bakery-supplies retailer, founded in Pretoria in 1999, distributing baking ingredients, pre-mixes, decorations and equipment to bakeries, restaurants, cafes and home bakers; this branch trades from Shop 25 in Lynnridge Mall, Lynnwood Ridge.

listings.name: Bank of Lisbon Building
listings.current_description: The Bank of Lisbon Building is a roughly 15,000 square-metre office building at 400 Paul Kruger Street in Pretoria Central, managed by property group Rebosis and upgraded internally and externally to serve as a business centre.

listings.name: Batsumi Travel
listings.current_description: Batsumi Travel is a 100% black woman-owned, Level 1 B-BBEE travel agency established in 2010 by Lisa Sebogodi, based in Colbyn, Pretoria, offering IATA- and ASATA-accredited corporate and leisure travel management, group travel and VIP travel services.

listings.name: Bauba Resources (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Bauba Resources (Pty) Ltd, incorporated in 1986 and based in Highveld, Centurion, is a mining and exploration company holding the Bauba platinum project in Limpopo's Bushveld Igneous Complex and a majority stake in the Moeijelijk Chrome Mine.

listings.name: BB GWM HAVAL Montana
listings.current_description: BB GWM Haval Montana is a car dealership in Montana Park selling GWM, P-Series, Ora and Tank vehicles, part of the BB Motor Group, which has operated for 65 years, offering trade-ins and finance through major banks.

listings.name: Bearings International - Rosslyn
listings.current_description: Bearings International - Rosslyn, a member of the Hudaco group with more than 60 years in the industry, supplies bearings and seals, chains and sprockets, belts and pulleys, and automotive products from Gaigher Street in Rosslyn, Akasia.

listings.name: Beyond Continuous Improvement
listings.current_description: Beyond Continuous Improvement (Pty) Ltd, founded in 2007 and based in Blue Valley Golf Estate, Centurion, is a business consultancy specialising in cost reduction, efficiency improvement, strategy review and implementation, procurement performance transformation and value-chain performance transformation.

listings.name: Blue Web Technologies
listings.current_description: Blue Web Technologies, based in Constantia Park with over 15 years in the IT industry, supports more than 330 active clients through IT outsourcing, networking, Microsoft Exchange email, cloud backup, web hosting, PBX/VoIP, and CCTV installation.

listings.name: Bluebell Hospitality Services
listings.current_description: Bluebell Hospitality Services provides guesthouse and lodge management support, including a central reservations office, online listings management on platforms such as Booking.com and Expedia, and direct and social media marketing, delivered on a monthly retainer basis.

listings.name: Bo Fire Maintenance Services
listings.current_description: Bo Fire Maintenance Services, part of the Centa Group and started in 2011, is a SAQCC- and SABS-registered fire safety provider in Riviera supplying, installing, and maintaining fire equipment and evacuation signage, and conducting fire risk assessments.

listings.name: BOKAKWENA(PTY)LTD
listings.current_description: Bokakwena (Pty) Ltd is a black-owned accounting and professional services firm in The Orchards, founded in 2017 by Reuben Nare Masoga, offering bookkeeping, taxation, B-BBEE advisory and verification, and financial and strategic consulting to individuals and corporates.

listings.name: Bossa Castle Walk
listings.current_description: Bossa is a fast-casual restaurant and bar franchise with locations across South Africa and Namibia, serving burgers, pizzas, breakfast, lunch and dinner menus, coffee and cocktails; this branch is at Castle Walk Shopping Centre in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria.

listings.name: BrainTrust Business Training
listings.current_description: BrainTrust Business Training is a QCTO- and Services SETA-accredited real estate training provider based in Colbyn, Pretoria, offering NQF 4 and 5 property practitioner qualifications, CPD courses, and learnerships, and states it has trained students since 2015.

listings.name: Brigade Elektronika (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Brigade Elektronika supplies vehicle safety systems, including reversing alarms, camera monitor systems, ultrasonic proximity sensors, digital recorders and thermal imaging cameras, as part of the global Brigade Electronics group founded in 1976, with operations in Kloofsig, Centurion.

listings.name: Brisen
listings.current_description: Brisen Commodities is a Centurion-based agricultural commodity trading company, established in 1996, specializing in grain trading (maize, wheat, soybeans, sorghum, sunflower), SAFEX risk management and hedging, brokerage, financing, and market advisory services for producers, millers, and traders.

listings.name: Buchel Homes & Paintcor ColourWays Watermeyer
listings.current_description: Buchel Homes & Paintcor ColourWays is a paint and home improvement supplier in Val-De-Grace, Pretoria, distributing paint, brushware, adhesives, sealers and accessories, including paint ranges rated for 5 to 15 years' durability, roof coatings and wood varnishes.

listings.name: Buffalo SA
listings.current_description: Buffalo SA, based in Rietondale, Pretoria, specialises in engineered retaining wall construction, gabions and civil infrastructure, along with concrete construction, site preparation and drainage solutions, operating since 1992 with regional bases in Gauteng and the Western Cape.

listings.name: Buku Office Supplies
listings.current_description: Buku Office Supplies, trading as Valinor Trading 238, is an East Lynne, Pretoria-based supplier of stationery, office furniture, computer consumables, filing and storage systems, office machines, and related office products to businesses, schools, and government departments countrywide.

listings.name: Business Point
listings.current_description: Business Point is an office services and printing business in Moreleta Park, Pretoria, offering printing, scanning, binding, laminating, courier services, stationery, wide-format banners, PVC vinyl and canvas printing, and branded merchandise such as t-shirts, caps, and mugs.

listings.name: Business Rescue
listings.current_description: Business Rescue is a Pretoria-based firm, established in 2001 and describing itself as South Africa's first dedicated business rescue company, that helps financially distressed companies assess rescue viability, manage creditor protection, restructure debt, and implement recovery plans.
